title: HSK1 Gate 12 · Tang Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 12: Tang Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第12关：唐朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 一千三百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫唐朝。唐朝最大的城叫长安，那时候，它是世界上最大的城。城里住了一百多万人，路又直又长。因为唐朝很有名，很多国家的人都来了。
passageEn: More than thirteen hundred years ago, China had a great dynasty called the Tang. The Tang's biggest city was Chang'an, and at that time it was the biggest city in the world. More than a million people lived there, and the streets were straight and long. Because the Tang was so famous, people came from many countries.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than thirteen hundred years ago, China had a great dynasty called the Tang.
comprehension.answer: 一千三百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫唐朝。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than a million people lived there, and the streets were straight and long.
comprehension.answer: 城里住了一百多万人，路又直又长。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 一 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“一”是什么意思？

check.explanation: “一”（yī）的意思是“one”，就在上面的短文里。

check.explanationEn: 多 (duō) means "more than" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “多”（duō）的意思是“more than”，就在上面的短文里。
